about_the_game:
Animal Game is a 2-4 player party brawler where death only makes you stronger! Choose from a large roster of adorable-but-deadly critters, then let the bloodbath commence in local or online multiplayer.

What DOES Kill You Makes You Stronger

When you eventually die, you get to pick from over 50 elemental upgrades and evolve into an even more ferocious predator. Choose fire to burn your enemies to a crisp, gain ice powers to freeze them into cubes, or mix different elements to gain the upper hand!

Don't Judge a Critter By Its Fluff

On top of the upgrade system, each animal has its own unique playstyle and abilities. As Kitty, you’ll slice and dice in close combat, while Bunny has a double jump for a quick getaway. To set yourself further apart from the herd, you’ll unlock skins as you dominate your enemies in the arena.

Teeth, Claws… AND GUNS

During the bloodshed, weapons will spawn all across the arena — so be quick on your paws and grab them before your foes do! Blast them full of holes with a sawed-off shotgun, chase them down with an Uzi, or cleave them in half with a giant axe!

Mark Your Territory

The stages aren’t just for show—they come in various sizes and layouts, offering tons of different play experiences. Each one features its own hazards, interactive elements, and platforms, so you best use the environments to gain the advantage over your enemies!

Your Place In The Food Chain

With countless weapons, characters, upgrades, and maps, there’s always something new to master. Whether you're a cub new to the genre or a bloodthirsty tiger with battle scars aplenty, our power-up system ensures that skill gaps won’t get in the way of a fun evening. So gather your friends, pick your favorite cute animal, and battle it out in an intense and bloody fight in Animal Game!

content_descriptors.notes: When animals kill each other, they explode in a cloud of blood and guts.

short_description: Animal Game is a frantic party brawler, where dying makes you stronger. Turn your friends into red goop with variety of over the top weapons, or use each animals unique abilities to get the upper hand! Evolve every time you die, to eventually become a storm of teeth and bullets!
